publishers.name: Emily Astranova
publishers.description: The official Castor plugins, made alongside Castor.

plugins.name: BloodHound bridge
plugins.description: Import a SharpHound collection (BloodHound CE): users, computers and domains as assets, sessions, admin rights and trusts as relationships, and everyone's shortest path to Domain Admins.

plugins.name: DOCX report
plugins.description: Write a project's findings, hosts and pinned notes as a Word document (.docx), attached to a card.

plugins.name: Watch folder
plugins.description: Files dropped in a folder on the Castor server go to their project: each becomes a card with the file attached, and a plugin that imports that kind of file (Nessus, SharpHound…) runs on it.

plugins.name: Mail DNS checks
plugins.description: Check a domain's mail records (MX, SPF and DMARC) with dig, as commands and a playbook.

plugins.name: Nessus import
plugins.description: Bring a .nessus scan into a project's assets: hosts, services and vulnerabilities, each linked to what it affects.

plugins.name: Shodan enrichment
plugins.description: Look up public hosts on Shodan as they're found: open ports, web servers, names and known CVEs.

plugins.name: Source Code Review
plugins.description: Source files, repositories and symbols as assets, with imports, calls, data flow and tests as relationships. Import a repository archive to map its files and imports, or add them by hand in the Code map.
